nodes.question: What limitation does the supervised learning framework impose on AI applications in bioacoustics?
nodes.answer: The supervised learning framework limits the application scope to predefined categories within a closed setting.

nodes.question: Why is automated analysis important in the context of ARUs?
nodes.answer: Automated analysis is essential because the manual review of the vast amount of audio data collected by ARUs is impractical.
